APCLetters.description: Letters — Art-Net slots 2 brightness, 3 red, 4 green, 5 blue

APCFestoon.description: Festoon — Art-Net slots 10 brightness, 11 red, 12 green, 13 blue

APCBypass.name: APCBypass
APCBypass.tip: When enabled, leave all pixel data untouched. This defaults ON for a safe first install.

APCControlBaseChannel.name: APCControlBaseChannel
APCControlBaseChannel.tip: FPP channel receiving Art-Net slot 1. Slots 1-13 must map consecutively from here. Recommended: 10001.

APCLettersStartChannel.name: APCLettersStartChannel
APCLettersStartChannel.tip: 1-based FPP start channel for the first Letters RGB pixel.

APCLettersPixels.name: APCLettersPixels
APCLettersPixels.tip: Number of RGB pixels in the Letters range.

APCLettersColorOrder.name: APCLettersColorOrder
APCLettersColorOrder.tip: RGB byte order in FPP channel data for this range. RGB is normally correct when output colour order is handled by the controller.

APCFestoonStartChannel.name: APCFestoonStartChannel
APCFestoonStartChannel.tip: 1-based FPP start channel for the first Festoon RGB pixel.

APCFestoonPixels.name: APCFestoonPixels
APCFestoonPixels.tip: Number of RGB pixels in the Festoon range.

APCFestoonColorOrder.name: APCFestoonColorOrder
APCFestoonColorOrder.tip: RGB byte order in FPP channel data for this range. RGB is normally correct when output colour order is handled by the controller.
